problem: A caller declaring a retained default plot-style graph could prebind its raw dictionary and placeholder identities for references before OBJECTS. The raw graph writer treated those matching tentative bindings as conflicting entities and refused the write.
change: Reuse the transactional source-identity promotion for the selected raw default-plot dictionary and placeholder before binding their emitted object identities. A conflicting target or actual entity remains a failure; record state rolls back if validation or commit fails.

validation.release: PASS: libdxfrw_dxf_default_plotstyle_graph across R2000 through R2018, ASCII and binary, identity and remapped handles. Matching prebindings write and read back; mismatched prebindings preserve a sentinel and corrected same-writer retries pass. Existing malformed graph controls remain active.
validation.asan: PASS: the same focused graph CTest under AddressSanitizer with leak detection disabled.
validation.related: PASS: libdxfrw_raw_application_writer and libdxfrw_raw_object_string_override_allocation. The raw-application reread test now selects its VENDOR_OBJECT by identity because the writer also emits its default plot-style placeholder.
validation.consumer: PASS: LibreCAD system-codec and bundled-codec fast CTests on the accompanying uncommitted adapter change; graph admission and consumer receipt are recorded separately after its commit.

limits: Generated controls do not qualify arbitrary caller plot-style graphs or native plotting.
The changed implementation digest reopens focused and package qualification; no support claims are promoted.
